requirement.description: The AsyncOptionBuilder implementation has incorrect handling of generator execution flow, particularly around StopIteration handling and None value processing. Many tests fail due to None values being improperly processed, causing TypeError when trying to perform arithmetic operations on None values.
requirement.contract: The async_option builder must properly process generators and handle StopIteration exceptions to correctly extract values and return appropriate Option types (Some or Nothing). The implementation should distinguish between values that should be returned vs. values that indicate completion.

requirement.description: The AsyncResultBuilder has the same fundamental issues as AsyncOptionBuilder in terms of generator handling, StopIteration processing, and None value interpretation. Tests fail due to improper handling of async generators and return values.
requirement.contract: The async_result builder must properly process async generators and handle StopIteration to correctly extract values and return appropriate Result types (Ok or Error). The implementation should distinguish between yielded values and return values properly.

requirement.description: The SeqBuilder incorrectly handles generator execution and StopIteration exceptions. The implementation fails to properly collect values from generators and doesn't handle the return value correctly.
requirement.contract: The seq builder must properly execute generators, collect yielded values, and handle return values correctly to produce proper sequences. The implementation should process generator yields and return values according to standard generator semantics.

requirement.description: The ResultBuilder inherits the base Builder class but has issues with StopIteration handling and generator processing. Some tests fail because the builder doesn't correctly interpret yielded values vs. return values from generators.
requirement.contract: The result builder must properly execute generators, correctly distinguish between yielded values and return values, and handle StopIteration exceptions to return appropriate Result types (Ok or Error).

requirement.description: The AsyncOptionBuilder implementation lacks proper async generator handling. It attempts to detect async generators but doesn't handle them correctly, leading to runtime errors when trying to await objects that aren't actually awaitable.
requirement.contract: The async_option builder must properly support async generators and handle them by awaiting their values, while still supporting regular generators. The implementation should correctly process async generator yields and handle async awaitables properly.
